assertions.name: which of rule 6's three shapes is this?
assertions.detail:
NEITHER an inert fix NOR two-guards-for-one-defect. The call-site cut alone restores the
              pre-round number; the ambient cut alone changes the answer too, differently. Two
              INDEPENDENT edit sites, each individually sufficient to change the measurement — so
              the round's 3-line single arm is sound but over-broad, and it could not have told
              an inert second edit from a load-bearing one. It is told here.
